en: For once, I didn't steal your map and I didn't steal your flashlight! Even I need vacation right?
Mmh? Did you lose your notebook? What a cat-astrophe! Why are you looking at me like that? I didn't do anything... Meow :3
Listen you shouldn't need it anymore, right? If you can't remember something, maybe someone else will. And if it's too hard, I don't know, maybe you can help each other out?
